research_question: Do Lower Egyptian nomes 16, 17 and 18 form only an administrative adjacency, or do Osirian relic lists independently load all three nodes with body-part/reassembly functions that could support a ritual-sequence hypothesis?

method.local_operator: BACK -> FORWARD -> LEFT -> RIGHT -> FORWARD -> BACK
method.rule: Do not assign cybernetic roles first. Recover the ancient relic/function at each nome, then test whether the sequence has functional continuity.

evidence: IFAO synthesis explicitly states that late Egyptian Osirian relic lists designate the Mendesian nome as seat of the phallus and backbone.
IFAO cites Dendara X, 89, 7-10 via Beinlich 1984 for the Lower Egyptian nome 16 relics.
A published translation of Dendera material renders the pair as phallus and backbone reassembled/found at Per-khet (Mendes).
Papyrus Brooklyn 47.218.84 identifies the Mendesian Osiris divine flesh called the Living with virile member and backbone.
LE16_MENDES.claim_ceiling: This establishes a ritual/theological relic localization, not a surviving original biological relic.

LE17_SEMA_BEHDET.place: Zmꜣ-Bḥd.t / Semabehdet / Diospolis Inferior / Tell el-Balamun

horus_behdetite.evidence: University of Chicago/ISAC dissertation devotes a chapter to the cult of Horus the Behdetite at the two cities called Behdet: Edfu and Tell el-Balamun.

LE17_SEMA_BEHDET.osiris_relic_evidence: Older Egyptological publication of the great Dendera Osiris text lists Diospolis in Lower Egypt among locations possessing Osiris relic pieces.

verified_components.Bḥd.t: Behdet place-name; also the 17th Lower Egyptian nome / Tell el-Balamun in TLA

etymology.reason: The lexical component zmꜣ is verified as unite/join, but a direct authoritative translation of the complete toponym as 'Uniting the Throne' has not yet been frozen from a primary lexicographic source.

osiris_relic.evidence: Édouard Naville's publication of the Festival-Hall of Osorkon II at Bubastis states that Ptolemaic lists mention a sanctuary of the divine mother containing the foot of Osiris, and elsewhere refers to the part of the Bubastis temple where one of the feet of Osiris was preserved.

sequence_result.current_body_part_vector: LE16 PHALLUS+BACKBONE -> LE17 UNKNOWN OSIRIS RELIC -> LE18 FOOT
sequence_result.reason_not_closed: The sequence now has Osirian relic loading on all three nodes, but the exact LE17 relic/function and an ancient text explicitly ordering 16->17->18 as one ritual process are still missing.

important_new_observation.statement: LE18 is no longer only a Bastet-side control. Bubastis independently preserves an Osiris body-part tradition involving a foot, so the 16-17-18 adjacency contains Osirian relic information on both confirmed outer nodes and an Osiris-relic locus at the middle node.
important_new_observation.impact: This raises the value of recovering the exact LE17 member because the middle node is now the sole missing variable in a three-node body-part sequence.

papyrus_jumilhac_candidate_bridge.observation: Secondary scholarly literature reports that Papyrus Jumilhac B 4,20ff states that Osiris' phallus was recovered and deposited in Mendes, contrasting with Plutarch's fish-loss account.
papyrus_jumilhac_candidate_bridge.why_important: If verified directly in Vandier's edition, this would provide an Egyptian-language narrative bridge from lost/recovered member to Mendes, materially strengthening GAP_C and reducing reliance on Plutarch for the loss/recovery route.

transception_interpretation.FORWARD: Dendera/Brooklyn independently predicts Mendes as phallus+backbone node
transception_interpretation.LEFT: LE17 provides Horus Behdetite cult plus Dendera Osiris-relic locality but member unknown
transception_interpretation.RIGHT: LE18 provides Bastet locality plus independently attested foot of Osiris
transception_interpretation.FORWARD_AGAIN: test whether exact LE17 member creates a coherent anatomical/ritual transition rather than imposing one
transception_interpretation.BACK_AGAIN: if LE17 does not fit, preserve three independent relic nodes and reject the pipeline interpretation

canonical_line: THE OUTER NODES NOW CARRY NAMED OSIRIAN BODY PARTS. THE MIDDLE NODE IS NO LONGER EMPTY; ONLY ITS MEMBER NAME IS MISSING. DO NOT INVENT IT — RECOVER IT.
